title: observability: token-level cost/latency metrics + KV tracing + dashboards and alert tuning
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: we need finer-grained observability to understand per-token unit economics and latency contributors across the serving stack (model, batching, KV cache). This PR adds token-level cost and latency metrics, introduces a KV cache tracing span (split out by hit/miss), updates Grafana dashboards with token-level breakdown panels, and tunes alert thresholds to reduce noisy paging while preserving SLO coverage. Summary of changes: 1) new prometheus metrics: redwood_token_processing_cost_us (histogram), redwood_token_latency_us (histogram), redwood_token_count_total (counter) and redwood_kv_cache_hit{true,false} (counter); 2) tracing: add kv_cache.span with tags for hit/miss, key_size, and cache_ttl; instrumented in runtime path where KV lookup occurs; 3) dashboards: updated /grafana/dashboards/serving_token_level.json with new panels (token cost heatmap, per-model token latency breakdown, KV hit-rate and cost-savings estimate); 4) alerts: tuned alert rules in /monitoring/alerts/token_level_alerts.yaml to use rate() windows aligned with request batching patterns and added suppression for transient KV warmups; 5) docs: updated docs/observability/token-level-metrics.md with examples and recommended queries; 6) test: added unit tests for metrics registration + integration smoke tests that run locally in dev harness. Risk and rollout: metrics names are additive and backward-compatible. Tracing tags are optional and safe to ignore for older consumers. Rollout plan: merge to main behind feature flag telemetry.token_level_enabled (default false) then enable for Canary pool only for 72h before global release. Rollback: toggle feature flag off and revert alert file if needed. Checklist: - [x] metrics and tracing instrumentation implemented - [x] grafana dashboard panels added - [x] alert thresholds reviewed with SRE - [x] docs updated - [x] smoke tests added - [x] staged rollout plan documented

review_comments: Diego Martinez: Overall looks good; can you include an example of the cost calculation used in the dashboard (tokens * unit_cost)? Also please ensure new metrics are tagged with model and route.
Asha Patel (author): Added cost calculation panel and ensured metrics include model, route, and instance_id tags. Updated dashboards and metrics registration.
Liam O'Connor: Alert noise concern - can we rate-limit notifications during autoscaler events? Suggest adding a suppression window when cluster-scaling is detected.

Asha Patel: Added suppression rule that checks for recent scaler events (prometheus rule referencing cluster_autoscaler_total) to avoid noisy alerts during scale-up. Also relaxed threshold for KV miss spike to 10m windows.
Mei Chen: Unit tests look good. One nit: prefer naming histogram buckets to align with existing latency buckets in runtime/metrics/constants.
Asha Patel: Renamed buckets to match constants and re-ran tests.
SRE approval: Approved for canary rollout. Please monitor token_cost_savings panel for first 48h.
release_notes: Added token-level cost and latency metrics, KV cache tracing spans, Grafana panels for token breakdowns, and tuned alerts to reduce noise. Rollout behind feature flag for controlled canary.
